title: Command palette

The admin has a command palette. Press :kbd{value="meta"} :kbd{value="K"} on macOS, or :kbd{value="ctrl"} :kbd{value="K"} on other systems. You can also click the search button at the top of the sidebar.

Type to filter. Press :kbd{value="enter"} to run the selected command.

## Groups

The palette shows these groups, in this order. An empty group does not show.

1. **Create.** One "New `<label>`" command for each content type. The command opens `newPath` of the type. Without `newPath`, it opens `<basePath>/new`. Without `basePath`, it opens `/admin/content/<name>/new`. The command shows only if the user has the `write` capability of the type.
2. **Go to.** Every admin nav item and nav child. A child shows its parent label as a suffix.
3. **Theme.** System, Light, and Dark.

Each destination shows once. The Create group is built first, so a nav link to a create path does not show again in Go to.

## Extend the palette

You do not write palette code. Use the normal extension points:

- A new content type adds a Create command.
- A new nav item adds a Go to command.
- A new settings page adds a Go to command with the suffix "Settings".

## Rules for a developer

- Navigate with `navigateTo` in `onSelect`. Do not set `to`.
- Keep `UDashboardSearch` and `UDashboardSearchButton` inside `UDashboardGroup`.
- Mount only one `UDashboardSearch` in the app. The palette opens through the global `dashboard:search:toggle` hook.

The group labels, the placeholder, and the command labels are translated.
